<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Users are locked out of the Keelwater claims portal and dashboard because they cannot reset their expired or forgotten passwords. This prevents them from accessing critical policyholder documents and performing essential claims tasks.

## Who is affected
- Five accounts have reported this issue via support [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- Linnet House Insurance, with an ARR of 360000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:8816911502d203bd].
- Tidewell Marine & Cargo, with an ARR of 420000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:0ad2bc981221b1c4].
- Merrow Vale Motor, with an ARR of 46000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a].
- Brackwater Homecover, with an ARR of 610000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:b454c97be44913b5].
- Marrowgate Commercial, with an ARR of 1600000.0 GBP, has reported this problem [i:b5ce42913f135e93].

## Evidence
- There have been seven mentions of this problem across one route [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- All seven mentions came through the support route [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- A user from Linnet House Insurance stated, I need to reset my password for the claims portal — can you guide me through it? [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49].
- A user from Tidewell Marine & Cargo stated, I need to reset my password because I can’t access the documents section for policyholders [i:0ad2bc981221b1c4].
- A user from Merrow Vale Motor stated, I’m locked out of our claims portal and need to reset my password urgently [i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a].
- A user from Brackwater Homecover stated, I need to reset my password because I’m locked out of the claims dashboard and can’t access policyholder documents [i:b454c97be44913b5].
- A user from Marrowgate Commercial stated, I need to reset my password for accessing the claims portal — can you guide me through that? [i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- The total ARR of the affected accounts is 3036000.0 GBP [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].

## Why now
- One renewal is due within the next 90 days, for Marrowgate Commercial on 2026-12-12 [i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- The problem has been reported consistently from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-25 [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:8816911502d203bd][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- The issue blocks access to time-sensitive claims tasks and documents, creating urgency for users who need immediate portal access [i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:a4c0f6232f2b2a0a][i:b454c97be44913b5].",
  "citations": ["0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49", "0ad2bc981221b1c4", "662c75b11af4fd54", "8816911502d203bd", "a4c0f6232f2b2a0a", "b454c97be44913b5", "b5ce42913f135e93"]
}
